name: Certified translation for immigration filings, and whether the certificate wording says what the rule needs

cadence_long: Nobody has been read, so nothing is re-read on any schedule; the day the first company is read, this line changes with it

note: BORN NOT FOR SALE 2026-08-25. The date is read off two dated files, not off this machine's clock, which reads two different days depending which setting is asked: revenue-2026/approvals/read_public_sites.md carries approved_on: 2026-08-25, and plans/new-revenue-2026-08/wave4-working/licences/summary-registers.json carries generated_utc: 2026-08-25T04:46:00Z. WHAT THIS PAGE IS: a public comparison table of the companies that produce certified English translations for United States immigration and court filings. Per company it will show what languages it covers, what its own website promises about turnaround, what its own website states about price, and whether the certificate wording it publishes contains what the rule requires. IT HAS NOUGHT COMPANIES ON IT TODAY AND IT SAYS SO IN WORDS. Nobody has been read, nothing has been checked, nothing has been published about anybody and nothing has been charged. The count is COUNTED at build time, never typed: scripts/slice_sworn_page.py looks for the lane at revenue-2026/projects/sworn_page and its store at revenue-2026/var/sworn_page_data.db, finds neither, and prints the number it counted. THERE IS NO ENGINE LANE BEHIND THIS PAGE AT ALL, which is why there is no scripts/family_status.py row for it and why the freshness board will show it as NOT WIRED UP. That is the honest reading, not an oversight: family_status answers 'has this family's collector stopped', and this family has no collector to stop. verified-record is the precedent and it sits on the same board the same way. The day a lane exists, whoever builds it adds the row. SAMPLE STATUS IS on-page AND IT IS ENFORCED, NOT ASSERTED. on-page is the catalog saying the whole of what we hold is printed on the page. With no store and no lane, what we hold is nothing, and printing the whole of nothing is what this page does: the rulebook, the licence basis, the bar, and a counted nought. It is NOT 'fail': 'fail' makes the page say 'sample not ready', which tells a stranger a file is on its way, and none is -- there is no file behind this page and there will not be one until a company is read. peak-call is on 'fail' for the opposite reason and the difference is the test: peak-call COUNTS hundreds of days of recorded grid load it does not print, so 'the whole of what we hold is printed here' is false there. Here there is nothing counted and nothing withheld. The builder refuses to build if that ever stops being true: a lane folder or a store with a row in it raises, and so does a store that exists but cannot be read, because unknown is not empty. THE WORDING CHECK IS CODE AND IT CANNOT RUN YET. The published rule text has not been fetched and no copy of it is saved: counted at build time as nought files matching cfr8-* under revenue-2026/research/sources, where every other saved statute in this estate lives. THE PAGE THEREFORE NAMES NO REGULATION NUMBER. A number does appear in a dated file -- plans/new-revenue-2026-08/wave4-working/S3.md, written 2026-08-24, line 93 -- but that same line says the citation was 'Cited from memory of the citation; the text itself UNKNOWN (not fetched)'. A number read out of a file that says it came from memory is still a number from memory, so it stays off the page and is written up as an OPERATOR DECISION in the hand-off instead. The page says 'the rule the check reads' and nothing more. The builder refuses to build the moment a saved copy appears, because the sentence 'nobody has fetched it' would have stopped being true. NO NUMBER, DATE, PRICE, GROUP, CADENCE OR BUYER IS TYPED INTO THE PAGE. price, group, cadence, cadence_long, buyer and short are read out of this row with no fallback. Every date is read out of a named dated file at build time: the approval's approved_on, the licence evidence's generated_utc and its evidence window, and the plan's own 'Written' line. Every sentence quoted from the plan is lifted out of the plan's table row for this build at build time, matched by its column heading rather than by position, so a reordered table stops the build instead of printing the wrong cell. THE PRICE IS LOCKED. The builder refuses to build unless this row's price is exactly 'Not for sale yet', because the page says in its own words that nothing here is for sale. It also refuses if any word it is about to print carries a dollar amount, so a price can never reach this page through the plan file either -- the plan's row for this build does carry one, in a cell this module never reads. NO COMPANY, NO PERSON, NO PRICE IS NAMED. The builder collects every hostname that appears anywhere in the licence evidence file and refuses to build if any of them is on the page. Two of those hosts were deliberately never fetched because their own crawl rules tell our reader to stay out; they are counted on the page and named nowhere on it. WHAT WE MAY READ, AND ON WHOSE SAY-SO: revenue-2026/approvals/read_public_sites.md, status ACTIVE, approved_on 2026-08-25. The page prints that file's own conditions and its own refusals, read out of it at build time, and the builder refuses to build if the status is not ACTIVE. The operator's own words in that file are NOT printed and neither is their name. THE KILL BAR IS THE PLAN'S, WORD FOR WORD, AND ITS CLOCK HAS NOT STARTED. The bar cell is read out of the plan's table row for this build. The clock runs from a PRICED page going live; this page is not priced, so no day of it has elapsed, and the page says that rather than printing a countdown. NO FORM, NO UPLOAD, NO ACCOUNT, NO SELF-SERVE ANYTHING. This estate's platform is not ours to add one to. A company that wants a row, or wants its row gone, writes to a person, which is what the contact block says. STILL TO WIRE, FOR WHOEVER MERGES THIS: nothing in scripts/. The fragment folds in with scripts/merge_catalog_adds.py, which deletes it. 'Comparison tables' is already in the ORDER list in scripts/build_hub.py, so the card draws itself. No scripts/family_status.py row -- see above.
